<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Supreme Court to review CEC status:</strong> The Supreme Court is set to hear multiple petitions on October 5 seeking the suspension or resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over controversial decisions regarding the Systematic Integrity Review (SIR).<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I18</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I25</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I31</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>BJP announces Rajya Sabha candidates:</strong> The BJP has nominated Koel Mallick for the West Bengal by-election and Dinesh Arya for the Uttarakhand Rajya Sabha seat, sparking political debate.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxPSDB2SGdOeTRhb3RSS1h5RDBEMWRMTWd1SDhqUFdaaUNzVHB6M3FnT3FjQldQUUs0QTY1OENxS1NESnNxcDRKZEpJdXVXZUhzYVR3YUo0dFNWcTVkODNrQnNDYTdLNGlBU3pWMGlpaHJ5RHNDel9ZLURCbDNnQlFFak1MMTc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I33</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Opposition plans EC protest:</strong> The INDIA bloc has scheduled a protest outside the Election Commission office in Delhi for October 7 to demand the resignation of the CEC over the ongoing SIR row.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I43</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I44</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I45</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Campaigning concludes in Nagaon:</strong> The BJP-NDA alliance has concluded its campaign for the Nagaon Lok Sabha by-election with extensive booth-level mobilization and padyatras.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Allegations of voter list manipulation:</strong> AIMIM leader Asaduddin Owaisi has alleged that BJP activists are filing Form 7 to systematically delete Muslim voters&#x27; names during the SIR process in Telangana.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google._?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a></span></li>
</ul>
